name: Disease and symptom

notes.purpose: Two ticked pigs raise the verb sheet; Condition is a tile under Health.
rules: Blocked verbs are omitted, not greyed; one line accounts for them.
edge: A missing Production strip (growers) is a reading, not a gap.

notes.purpose: The whole add flow is one sheet: conditions, triage preset and the primary that says what it writes.

elements.name: Triage
elements.rule: Triage rides inline with the preset Monitor because no null level exists. Its option hints carry the consequences.

rules: The drawer is the review: the picker step, the confirm card, the read-only roster and the toast were removed.
view > filters the live list, which can still deselect.

notes.purpose: One flat list under body-system groups with search; each entry carries its class silently.

elements.name: Condition row
elements.shows: Name, class behind the info icon, and how many of the selected pigs already carry it
elements.logic: The per-item count answers "already carrying" before the tick. A fever writes a case with a day count; a hernia writes a characteristic on the pig page.

rules: Groups are body words (Belly), never the class (Standing). The footnote states a consequence: a tick adds no second case.
edge: Ambiguous entries split in the catalogue (injury versus chronic lameness) rather than asking the farmer.

screens.name: After adding · list is the receipt

notes.purpose: The walk list after commit: rows update in place, selection clears, scroll is kept.

elements.name: What prints
elements.shows: The walk list after commit: rows update in place, selection clears, scroll is kept.

states.when: Pig did not carry the condition
states.shows: Opens at today with the amber dot (Monitor preset: dot, no trail means watching)
No duplicate case; day count keeps aging

screens.name: Resolve · one pig
screens.zh: 康复 / 移除 · 单只

notes.purpose: One pig: her open cases as verdict lines, Recover (big tick, left) and Strike (small chip, right).

elements.name: Verdict line
elements.shows: One open condition with its trail
elements.rule: Left tick = Recover (the outcome, the walk's normal act). Right chip "wrong" = Strike (correction of a wrong entry). Characteristics never appear.

edge: A hernia ends by correction on the pig record, not here.

screens.name: Resolve · verdict page
screens.zh: 康复 / 移除 · 多只

notes.purpose: Several pigs: one line per pig and open condition, pen-grouped, in the walk row grammar.
rules: The master row and pen headers are recover-all shortcuts.
The primary is disabled at zero verdicts.
The zero rule keeps pigs with nothing open off the page; the footnote counts them.
edge: Production was condition-major (one line per disease across 10 pigs); this page is pig-major and the condition-major shortcuts are cut.

screens.name: Resolve · verdicts in place
screens.zh: 康复 / 移除 · 已选

notes.purpose: Mixed verdicts on one page: recover some, strike one, one commit.

elements.name: Verdict lines
elements.shows: Mixed verdicts on one page: recover some, strike one, one commit.

states.shows: Line marked to close as recovered
Row struck through (struck · wrong entry) with an undo
Recovers by count; an inline stepper lowers the number (12 to 5)

rules: One commit carries both verbs; no mode switch, no leave guard.
Strike is plain human-error correction: no KPI language; the audit keeps the record.

notes.purpose: The walk list after commit: what remains is what prints.
rules: Recovery prints as silence: closed lines vanish and nothing says "recovered". The group ledger re-aggregates (12 to 7).
A struck entry prints nothing anywhere; audit keeps it, history lines do not. No toast.

flow: tap Condition in the verb sheet
tap Recover or the wrong-entry chip
